record.field: Early Stage (Preclinical / Phase 1) - HBM Updated Criteria

Applies to early-stage in-licensing opportunities — assets at preclinical or Phase 1 stage, sourced primarily from Chinese biotech. Use this profile when the material describes a single drug-candidate opportunity, includes information about therapeutic area, modality, development stage, preclinical/clinical data, deal territory and originating company. Do NOT use this profile for late-stage assets (Phase 2/3, approved), for non-drug opportunities (devices, diagnostics, services), or when the material is a company-level overview without a specific candidate.
Criteria reflect Harbour BioMed's updated screening approach agreed on 5/14: immunology focus, antibody/biologics-first modality, close-to-IND with a complete data package, Global + China rights, and a Chinese-biotech / platform-company origin with at least one clinically validated or PCC-advanced asset.
TA Focus: Immunology

The asset's primary therapeutic area is immunology (including immuno-oncology). Non-aligned therapeutic areas are a direct pass — fail this rule if the asset's primary TA is not immunology / immuno-oncology.
Modality: Antibody / Biologics

The modality is an antibody or biologic. Small molecules are accepted only if they are at IND stage AND show strong differentiation (case-by-case). RNA / siRNA and other modalities outside antibody / biologics are a fail unless they meet the IND-stage + strong-differentiation exception.
Stage: Close-to-IND with Complete Data Package

The asset is close to IND with a complete data package. Pre-PCC assets are acceptable ONLY if the originating platform has produced at least one clinically validated asset. Earlier / pre-PCC assets from platforms without a clinically validated asset fail this rule.
Required Data: Mouse Efficacy + Monkey PK
Scientific data package must include, at minimum, mouse efficacy data AND monkey PK data. If either is missing or not disclosed in the material, mark needs_info; if explicitly absent, fail.
Molecule Readiness for BsAb / TriAb

If the asset is a bispecific antibody (BsAb) or trispecific antibody (TriAb), the molecule itself must be ready (sequence finalized, expressible, developability assessed). Not applicable if the asset is a conventional monoclonal antibody or non-multispecific biologic.
Territory: Global + China Rights
The deal must convey Global rights AND China rights, covering both clinical development and commercialization. Deals limited to ex-China or ex-Global rights fail this rule.
Company Type: Chinese Biotech (Platforms with Validated Asset)

The originating company is a Chinese biotech (primary target). Platform companies are acceptable only if they can demonstrate at least one clinically validated asset OR a PCC-advanced asset. Non-Chinese non-platform companies, or platform companies without a validated / PCC-advanced asset, fail this rule.
Mid-to-Late Stage (Phase 2 / Phase 3) - HBM Updated Criteria

Applies to mid-to-late-stage in-licensing opportunities — assets at Phase 2 or Phase 3, with human efficacy / safety data already in hand. Use this profile when the material describes a clinical-stage drug candidate (Phase 2a or later) and includes information about therapeutic area, modality, development stage / readouts, and deal territory. Do NOT use this profile for preclinical or Phase 1 assets (use the Early-Stage profile instead), for non-drug opportunities, or when the material is a company-level overview without a specific candidate.
Criteria reflect Harbour BioMed's updated screening approach agreed on 5/14: Greater China rights are mandatory and partial Global rights are now additionally sought; immunology + adjacent TAs (GI, Respiratory, Dermatology, systemic inflammatory); modality-agnostic except gene therapy and probiotics; minimum Global Ph1 finished, with emphasis on human PoC and clear dose-response.
Rights: Greater China (Mandatory) + Partial Global

The deal MUST convey Greater China rights (clinical & commercial) — this is a hard requirement. The updated approach additionally seeks partial Global rights: a deal with Greater China only is acceptable but a deal that also includes partial Global rights is preferred. Fail this rule if Greater China rights are missing or restricted; flag needs_info if rights scope is not disclosed.
TA Focus: Immunology + Adjacent Fields

The asset's primary therapeutic area is immunology OR one of the adjacent fields: gastroenterology (GI), respiratory, dermatology, or systemic inflammatory disease. Assets outside this set fail this rule.
Modality: Agnostic (Exclude Gene Therapy / Probiotics)
Modality is agnostic — antibody, small molecule, peptide, RNA, cell therapy, etc. are all acceptable. EXCLUDE gene therapy and probiotics: assets in these two modality classes fail this rule.
Stage: Phase 2a+ with Human Efficacy / Safety Data

The asset is at Phase 2a or later AND has human efficacy and safety data. Minimum acceptable bar is a completed Global Phase 1; base case is Global Phase 2; best case is Global Phase 3. Assets earlier than completed Global Ph1, or lacking human efficacy/safety readouts, fail this rule.
Human PoC + Clear Dose-Response

The material must demonstrate human proof-of-concept AND a clear dose-response relationship. This is an explicit emphasis under the updated approach. If PoC is present but dose-response is unclear, mark needs_info. If neither is supported by the data, fail.
